subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: What cross-platform npm installer failure policy should OpenClaw ship for retries, auto-repair, and fail-closed behavior?
rationale: The requested behavior spans installer UX, npm/network retries, platform-specific permission repair, and security-sensitive failure classes, so automation should not choose retry or remediation semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Conservative structured policy
options.body: Add structured extraction and user-facing remediation while retrying only clearly transient network failures and keeping certificate/security and persistent local failures explicit.

options.title: Broader automatic repair
options.body: Attempt safe permission or prefix repairs after EACCES-style failures and retry only when the repair succeeds, with platform-specific tests and rollback behavior.

options.title: Diagnostics-only first
options.body: Keep install execution mostly unchanged while improving error messages and docs, then revisit retries after more live failures are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Conservative structured policy
recommendation.body: Add structured extraction and user-facing remediation while retrying only clearly transient network failures and keeping certificate/security and persistent local failures explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: The broad policy crosses POSIX installer diagnostics and Docker setup behavior where steipete has recent path-specific history.
